summary: Eastern International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board approved increasing board size from five to seven members and appointed two new directors, Chi Wing Ma and Yuanjiang Zhang, effective May 18, 2026. The appointments fill vacancies created by the expansion, with Mr. Ma serving as a director and Mr. Zhang as an independent director under NASDAQ rules. Each entered into director agreements with customary confidentiality obligations; Mr. Ma receives $8,500/month and Mr. Zhang $1,000/quarter. This is a routine board expansion and director appointment, not a special situation event. No other material corporate transactions or strategic changes are disclosed.
